output.title: Where to find the member website wording for a drug price estimate
output.draft_text:
Q: Where is the member website wording for the drug price estimate?

A: The wording members see with a drug price estimate on the member website is located at [website page or section name, e.g. menu path to the drug price estimate tool]. The approved text for advocates is kept in [knowledge base or document location of the approved wording], owned by [owning team].

When a member asks about a drug price estimate shown on the member website:
1. Open [tool or screen advocates use to view the member's drug price estimate].
2. If the wording must be read to the member, read it [word for word / in summary] as written in [location of the approved wording]: "[approved drug price estimate wording]".
3. Do not use the medical visit cost disclaimer (U-BEN-COST-001-02) for drug prices. That disclaimer covers covered in-network medical visits only.
4. If you cannot find the wording or the member sees different wording on the website, [escalation step or team to contact].

[knowledge base or document location of the approved wording]

author_checklist: Confirm that approved member website wording for drug price estimates exists, and get its exact current text from the owning team.
Confirm where the drug price estimate appears on the member website, including the page name or navigation path.
Confirm whether Legal requires the wording to be read verbatim. If so, create or link a separate Legal verbatim unit, which may belong in shared-legal, rather than embedding the text here.
Confirm which tool or screen advocates use to see a member's drug price estimate.
Confirm that the medical visit disclaimer U-BEN-COST-001-02 must not be used for drug prices, or name the correct alternative.
Confirm the escalation path when the wording is missing or does not match what the member sees.
Confirm the owning team and the review cadence so the unit stays in sync with website changes.
Confirm the correct knowledge base: pharmacy, or shared-legal if the content is mainly Legal wording.
